newsitem.title: UK: Easynet signs Internet deal with EMAP.
newsitem.headline: Easynet signs Internet deal with EMAP.

text.p: Easynet Group Plc said on Wednesday it had reached a deal with EMAP Computing, a division of media giant EMAP Plc, giving it control over provision of content on its Internet UKOnline web-site.

EMAP Computing will provide material for the website and Easynet will still deal with other subscriber services, receiving a slice of advertising revenues from the site. The deal will run for an initial three year period.
